feature_name: Team Email Recipient Support in Documents Table
description: Update the documents table to properly identify users when they are recipients via team email addresses. Currently, action buttons and title links don't appear for users who receive documents through team emails rather than their personal email addresses.
functional_requirements: Include team email addresses in the organisation session data so they're accessible on the client side
Modify recipient matching logic to check both user email and team email when determining if the current user is a document recipient
Apply the updated recipient matching across all documents table components (action buttons, dropdowns, title links, and main table)
